app.title: Comink
app.subtitle: Real-time social platform for students & small communities
app.description: A micro social network centered around real-time messaging and high-fidelity voice/video calls.
app.backend_offline: Cannot connect to Backend (please start dotnet run in /backend/src/Comink.Api)
app.feature_identity_desc: Registration, dual-token JWT auth, session security and student profiles.
app.feature_social_desc: Friend requests, follow, post updates with media attachments, comments and reactions.
app.feature_messaging_desc: Instant 1-on-1 and group chat via SignalR, persistent message history with cursor pagination.
app.feature_calls_desc: High-fidelity WebRTC calls powered by LiveKit and integrated TURN.
